text:
maria-se: Heads up — customer ran a SOC2 questionnaire and asked 3 quick things we should answer within 48h: 1) key rotation cadence + who holds CMKs, 2) how we notify/engage subprocessors for KMS/encryption changes, 3) ad-hoc log access approval flow. Can someone from sec/ops summarize?

sanjay-sec: Quick answers incoming, will draft bullets and link artifacts.

elaine-ops: For operations: access to customer logs is gated. Process: create JIRA ticket (SEC-ACCESS), include justification + duration + customer rep. Security + PM or Account Exec must approve. We enable time-bound access with session recording and audit entries.

maria-se: do we have a link to the standard checklist I can share? customer expects concrete steps.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-4823 for this question (automated).

jeff-legal: For SOC2 artifacts we can provide policy docs and redaction proofs; we cannot share CMKs or private key material. We can provide rotation logs and signed subprocessors list.

claire-privacy: Redaction & retention note: our hosted service strips obvious PII using the pipeline; default retention for raw traces is 30 days (configurable by contract). We can provide sample redaction config.

maria-se: can you drop a tight set of bullets I can paste into the questionnaire?

sanjay-sec: Here — paste-ready bullets: 
- Key custody: Hosted (default) — provider-managed keys encrypted at rest with provider KMS; Dedicated/Private — support customer-managed keys (CMEK) via customer KMS/HSM. We never export customer CMKs.
- Rotation cadence: Provider-managed keys rotate per cloud provider policy (typically annual). For CMEK we rely on customer's rotation policy; if requested we can coordinate rotation operations and provide rotation proofs (KMS key rotation/logs).
- Subprocessors: We maintain an up-to-date subprocessors list and notify customers per contract. Typical subprocessors: CloudProvider (compute/storage), MonitoringVendor (logs/metrics), CDN. We can provide the list and last-notified date.
- Log access: Ad-hoc access requires SEC-ACCESS JIRA ticket, approval from Security + PM/AE, justification and time-bound access. All access is audited and recorded.
- Redaction: Default automated PII redaction applied; retention 30 days by default; additional redaction or longer retention available under contract.

claire-privacy: sample redaction snippet (internal config):
```
redaction:
  pii_fields: ["email", "ssn", "credit_card"]
  retention_days: 30
  redact_on_ingest: true
```

jeff-legal: Add: we can supply SOC2/ISO artifacts showing the controls and the subprocessors attestation; legal can sign an NDA or addendum for extra disclosure.

elaine-ops: Ops note: if the customer wants us to use their KMS, we need a network change window for Dedicated/Private and a short runbook. ETA to produce the runbook and rotation proof: 2 business days.

maria-se: perfect — thanks all. I'll paste these and ping if they ask for runbook or rotation logs. cc @elaine-ops @jeff-legal :thumbsup:

sanjay-sec: added a short FAQ to the internal security docs — https://redwood.internal/security/kms-ops (internal). :eyes:

sec-bot: Logged audit entry: SEC-4823 created by maria-se.

maria-se: closing loop — customer wants the bullets + confirmation we'll follow up with runbook within 48h. I'll update ticket. Thanks!
